spec.name: Orange Pets raccoon dark
spec.description: A stocky charcoal raccoon pet with a black eye mask, cream muzzle, square ears and a thick ringed tail. Ten cuboids, approximately eight units tall, with explicit clearance above the legs and behind the torso.

prompt: Generate a real raccoon pet in vanilla Minecraft pixel-art cuboid style, with a deep charcoal grey coat, black eye mask, cream muzzle, little square ears, stocky body and long thick black-ringed tail. This is a coat variant for Orange Pets. Centre [8,0,8], height around 8 units, sixteen units per block. Under 20 cubes. One root bone with head, body, four legs and tail. CRITICAL: leg tops must end below torso with 0.25 units clearance, no embedded/coplanar outward faces. Tail beyond rear surface with clearance. All motion must preserve cube clearance. No accessory or scene. Keep natural animal shape.
